subject.title: fix(protocol): refresh plugin approval Swift model

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled PR be closed as superseded by current main, or repaired before any landing path?
rationale: Automation should not close a `maintainer`-labeled PR, and the remaining choice is whether maintainers want to treat the current-main direct commit as canonical or fix the generated Swift initializer compatibility before shipping.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Current main commit 1403c647 already contains the same generated Swift output, so this branch no longer needs to land.

options.title: Repair before landing
options.body: Add `PluginApprovalRequestParams.approvalReviewerDeviceIds` to the Swift generator default-nil compatibility list, regenerate, and add a focused compatibility test before using this PR as the landing path.

options.title: Accept the source break
options.body: Maintainers can decide the generated initializer is not a source-compatibility contract, but that should be an explicit compatibility choice.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Current main commit 1403c647 already contains the same generated Swift output, so this branch no longer needs to land.
